'''R5-X2''' was an [[R5 series astromech droid]] who served in the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. The [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]],<ref name="TBR2D2" /> who also acted as the grandmaster host of the [[Boonta Eve Classic]],<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> used the [[astromech droid]] as a high-speed calculator to determine betting odds for [[Podracing|podraces]].<ref name="TBR2D2" />

In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="EP1Date">{{FilmDate|I}}</ref> R5-X2 attended the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)|Boonta Eve Classic podrace]] held at the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], where it stood alongside Jabba. When the Hutt announced the beginning of the race, the [[droid]] was positioned next to one of Jabba’s [[Klatooinian]] [[Mercenary|mercenaries]].<ref name="TPM" /> As an [[R-series]] astromech, R5-X2 was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="R5-series note" /> and featured [[Color|red-and-white]] plating with red [[sensor]]s.<ref name="TBR2D2" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-X2 first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the droid was first identified in [[Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2 22|''Star Wars: Build Your Own R2-D2'' 22]],<ref name="TBR2D2" /> published by [[De Agostini]] in [[June]] [[2017]].<ref name="Date">{{R2Dates|22}}</ref> The designation originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the [[R5-X2/Legends|droid]] was first identified in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds]]<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and published on [[September 15]], 1999.<ref name="DK">{{DK|subdomain=us|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,11_0789447010,00.html|text=Star Wars Episode 1: Visual Dictionary|nolive=1}}</ref>

In the non-canon [[LEGO]] short episode "Jabba Jumps Into the Race," part of the ''[[LEGO Star Wars Movie Short|Star Wars Stop-Motion Stories]]'' released on [[August 11]], [[2019]], an astromech droid similar to R5-X2 appeared at the Boonta Eve Classic alongside Jabba the Hutt and a mercenary. However, the droid was depicted as an [[R2-series astromech droid|R2-series unit]] rather than an R5, and the mercenary was shown as a [[Weequay]] instead of a Klatooinian.<ref name="Jabba Jumps Into The Race">{{LegoMiniMovie|series=Stop-Motion Story|text=Jabba Jumps Into The Race|video=0gPtxt6hnv8}}</ref>
